_about: Public-domain Jean-Joseph Surin (1600-1665), French Jesuit mystic, for the Word Hoard: The Foundations of the Spiritual Life, drawn from the Imitation of Jesus Christ (London: James Burns, 1844) and the Spiritual Letters of Father Surin translated by Sister M. Christopher (undated, catalogued 1892), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 37 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
